newsitem.title: USA: Tecumseh sees weather hurting compresor demand.
newsitem.headline: Tecumseh sees weather hurting compresor demand.

text.p: Tecumseh Products Co said Thursday that North American compressor demand should be weakened through the rest of the year and possibly into 1997.

An unseasonably cool summer in key regions of the United States has led to higher than usual levels of room air conditioners remaining in distribution channels at the end of the summer season, while the commercial refrigeration market also continues to show signs of weakness, Tecumseh said.
Tecumseh manufacturers hermetic compressors for air conditioning and refrigeration products, gasoline engines and power train products for lawn and garden applications, and pumps.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported net income of $27.2 million, or $1.24 a share in the third quarter, compared with $24.9 million, or $1.14 a share a year ago.
Tecumseh's class A shares were unchanged at 56-3/4 on Nasdaq Thursday.
